english.title: Operator or remote pilot cause restraining device longer than 25m on tethered small unmanned aircraft
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the UAS operator]_
(B)_[a remote pilot]_

of a tethered small unmanned aircraft, caused or permitted the aircraft to be flown where the limit imposed by the restraining device was more than 25m long
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 265E(5)(b) and (7) and 265F(5)(c) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
